description.zh: ACL检查详情中的ACL策略唯一标识ID。
description.en: The unique identifier ID of the ACL policy in the ACL check details.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 10 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please call this API appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw update-acl-check-detail-status --lang zh --task-id task-c92d4544ef7b6a42 --uuid bbbb43c9-a931-4d89-9939-86d509139a20 --status Pending --region cn-hangzhou
